name: Puntland
subtitle: Northern Blue Frontier
tagline: Where the desert mountains meet the deep waters of the Gulf of Aden and Indian Ocean.
description: Home to the northernmost tip of Africa at Cape Guardafui, Puntland features rugged coastal cliffs, ancient frankincense trading ports, rich upwelling zones, and some of the highest pelagic biodiversity in the Western Indian Ocean.
highlights: Ancient Ras Hafun peninsula & salt flats

name: Jubaland
subtitle: Southern Coral Archipelago
tagline: Lush tropical coastlines, mangrove estuaries, and remote untouched island atolls.
description: Extending to the southern frontier of Somalia, Jubaland boasts pristine white sandy beaches, extensive mangrove estuaries around the Jubba river mouth, and the legendary Bajuni Archipelago with turquoise coral lagoons.
highlights: Ras Kamboni remote sea turtle nesting sands

name: Central & Southern Coast
subtitle: Historical Maritime Seaboard
tagline: Africa's longest continuous coastline, steeped in centuries of Indian Ocean trade.
description: From the historical Sultanate ports of Mogadishu, Marka, and Barawe to the windswept headlands of Hobyo, this central coastline is characterized by vast dunes, endless ocean horizons, and historic coral-stone architecture.
highlights: Historic coral-stone ports of Marka & Barawe
